decision_summary: Decide first: REQ-012/AC-003 contradicts the active rule R-007 and no change is declared. Accept the proposed modify declaration, or reword the AC. Checked RC-1 to RC-9 against the area's rules registry; RC-8 had no domain plugin for this area.

findings.text: The AC allows cancelling an order after dispatch; R-007 says a dispatched order cannot be cancelled. No changes[] entry declares the difference.
findings.rewording: Given a dispatched order, when the customer requests cancellation, then the request is refused with error ORDER_ALREADY_DISPATCHED.

findings.text: AC-002 relies on the order-limit condition of R-004 but no negative or boundary AC covers the limit.
findings.rewording: Add a boundary AC: given a basket at the order limit, when one more item is added, then the add is refused.

questions.text: Should customers be able to cancel a dispatched order?

options.text: Option A: keep the current wording.
Option B: narrow it as the finding suggests.

proposed_changes.proposed_statement: A dispatched order can be cancelled until it is delivered.

given: A customer with an open basket below the order limit
then: The item is in the basket
